title: CSV value formats: Margin % plain number, dates mm-dd-yyyy, currency plain numbers, no color
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 14 S14-R10; S14-R11; S14-R12; S14-R13
custom_preconds: 1. You have downloaded a CSV containing rows with real values, including (if seedable) a row whose Subtotal is zero or below.
custom_steps:
1. Read a Margin % cell, a Date cell, and a currency cell in a text editor.
2. Check the row whose Subtotal is ≤ 0.
custom_expected:
1. Margin % is a plain number to one decimal with no percent sign (for example, 64.7); it is EMPTY when the row's Subtotal is zero or below.
2. Dates export as mm-dd-yyyy — for example, 05-14-2026.
3. Currency values are plain numbers with no dollar sign and no thousands separators.
4. The CSV has no color; the signed Inv. Hrs value still conveys direction.
